Name: Ahlitah82FirstMod
Author: ahlitah82
Description:
I do know it works with DaisyNeko's Earthy Recolours, because I have that installed.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher only.

As of this moment, it is just the standard farm with all of the fences and cliffs removed, except where Grandpa's Shrine, the farm cave, and the warp point are. Between the shrine and the cave I replaced most of the cliff with a pond and removed the two ponds that were in the prime farming area. I fully intend to mess with this more, add custom areas for animals, move the farmhouse, etc, when I figure out how ;). And yes, I am actively trying to figure out why all of the stuff in the farmhouse is gone. Thanks for trying it out! 

if you need a tv, I suggest CJB Item Spawner so that you can just get one and put it in as soon as you load into the map. Have fun!

Edit:
I fixed the description when you're making a new map, still working on the furniture though. thanks!

2nd Edit:

I fixed the furniture!!
also, the location of the farmhouse, mailbox, shipping bin, and pet bowl have been moved! And better starting package!

3rd Edit:
Took some advice and added a tiny pond so filling the watering can is easier! Also, changed the starting location of the greenhouse and the spouse's area. Also added some blue grass at the bottom, for animals. 

Thanks!!!

Downloads.Description: Changed starting location of greenhouse and spouse area, new starter package, added a pond near the path on the right for easier watering can filling. Can also fish Mountain fish here now!
